selectionCriteria.userDemand: A named platform use case and roadmap requirement must require the integration.
selectionCriteria.maintenanceHealth: The dependency or host boundary must have an identified owner and review path.
selectionCriteria.licensing: Distributed dependencies must satisfy the repository license policy; host dependencies remain operator-owned.
selectionCriteria.deployment: The integration must fit a supported profile or an explicit host-owned isolation boundary.
selectionCriteria.conformance: Domain behavior, failure semantics, authorization, lifecycle, and operational evidence must be tested.

supportTiers.production: Release-blocking package with domain, security, lifecycle, and operational evidence.
supportTiers.optional: Supported package for explicitly validated use cases with host-owned external dependencies.
supportTiers.host-boundary: Supported Nao contract and guidance; the application owns vendor selection, credentials, availability, and operations.

selection.userDemand: Production semantic retrieval for grounded RAG.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Owned with the PostgreSQL knowledge adapter and exercised against a real database.
selection.licensing: Pgvector and PostgreSQL are covered by the approved dependency and external-service policy.
selection.deployment: Runs against operator-managed PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension.
selection.conformance: Authorization filters, ranking, mutation lifecycle, backup, restore, deletion, and benchmarks are tested.

selection.userDemand: Production keyword retrieval and hybrid fusion.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Uses the same owned PostgreSQL adapter and integration-test surface as vector retrieval.
selection.licensing: PostgreSQL is an operator-supplied external service under the approved policy.
selection.deployment: Uses built-in PostgreSQL full-text search without another service.
selection.conformance: Authorization filters, ranking, mutation lifecycle, backup, restore, and deletion are tested.

selection.userDemand: Durable graph memory and graph-enhanced retrieval require a production graph store.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Owned with the PostgreSQL persistence adapters and exercised against a real database.
selection.licensing: PostgreSQL is an operator-supplied external service under the approved policy.
selection.deployment: Reuses supported PostgreSQL deployment, backup, isolation, and recovery controls.
selection.conformance: Tenant isolation, concurrent mutation, lifecycle, restore, and physical deletion are tested.

integrations.graphJustification: BRG-02 requires graph neighborhoods as independently evaluated retrieval candidates.

selection.userDemand: Standard traces, metrics, logs, and Prometheus projection for production operations.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Built on the maintained OpenTelemetry .NET packages with a dedicated integration suite.
selection.licensing: Managed dependencies pass the repository license policy.
selection.deployment: Supports authenticated OTLP endpoints and host-exposed Prometheus scraping.
selection.conformance: Identity correlation, privacy, backpressure, retry, flush, shutdown, and protocol export are tested.

selection.userDemand: Enterprise OIDC and OAuth claims must map into Nao authorization identities.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Provider-neutral adapter is owned and covered by fail-closed security tests.
selection.licensing: Uses platform claims APIs and introduces no vendor SDK.
selection.deployment: Composes behind host authentication middleware in every supported host profile.
selection.conformance: Authentication, claims, delegation, impersonation, ambiguity, and malformed authority fail closed.

selection.userDemand: Providers, workers, and connectors require authorized secret resolution without secret-bearing configuration.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Nao owns the provider contract while applications own their selected enterprise vault.
selection.licensing: No vendor SDK is imposed; the host reviews its vault client and license.
selection.deployment: Workload identity resolves references at the host boundary and never places values in manifests.
selection.conformance: Reference binding, authorization scope, cancellation, rotation, revocation, mismatch, and redaction are tested.

selection.userDemand: Validated typed rule use cases require stratified Datalog derivations.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Nao owns the typed compiler and protocol; the host owns the isolated Souffle executable.
selection.licensing: The executable is host-supplied and not redistributed by Nao.
selection.deployment: Runs only through a host-owned filesystem, network, and process-isolated boundary.
selection.conformance: Typing, safety, stratification, limits, engine identity, bindings, derivations, and failures are tested.

selection.userDemand: Validated finite-domain scheduling and constraint use cases require exact models and unsat evidence.
selection.maintenanceHealth: Nao owns the typed compiler and protocol; the host owns the isolated Z3 executable.
selection.licensing: The executable is host-supplied and not redistributed by Nao.
selection.deployment: Runs only through a host-owned filesystem, network, and child-process-isolated boundary.
selection.conformance: Sorts, bounds, models, unsat cores, objectives, limits, engine identity, and failures are tested.
